title: tanacetum santolinoides
intro: Tanacetum santolinoides, commonly known as Santolina, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory activities, which can aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum santolinoides include its ability to exhibit expectorant and diuretic properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and fluid retention. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
